relations.subject: Julius Jolly
relations.evidence: Jolly was born in Heidelberg, the son of physicist Philipp Johann Gustav von Jolly (1809–1884)

relations.subject: Julius Jolly
relations.evidence: Jolly became a Professor in the University of Würzburg in 1877, in the fields of comparative linguistics and Sanskrit.

relations.subject: Julius Jolly
relations.evidence: He retired in 1922, when he became co-editor of the Journal of Indian History, but continued to give lectures in Würzburg till 1928.

relations.subject: Julius Jolly
relations.evidence: In 1882–1883 he visited India as Tagore professor of law, Calcutta

relations.subject: Julius Jolly
relations.evidence: He published a new critical edition of Kautilya's Arthashastra in collaboration with R. Schmidt in the "Panjab Sanskrit Series", 1923–1924.
